answer: Yes, Corning has positive working capital based on FY2022 data. As of December 31, 2022, Corning reported Total Current Assets of $7,453 million and Total Current Liabilities of $5,175 million, resulting in positive working capital of $2,278 million ($7,453 million minus $5,175 million).
rationale: Total current assets of $7,453 million exceed total current liabilities of $5,175 million, resulting in positive working capital of $2,278 million for FY2022.
